title: A Digital Twin of Eden Gardens: Simulating Kolkata Knight Riders’s Home Conditions
dek: What would a digital twin of Eden Gardens need to know? The parameters are already in the data: scoring, chasing, six-hitting, and how pace and spin fare.
excerpt: A simulation of Eden Gardens starts with a handful of measured parameters. Here they are, from first-innings scores to pace and spin economy, set against the rest of the IPL.

sections.heading: What a Digital Twin Is
body: A digital twin is a simulation calibrated to a real place. For a cricket ground, it would let a team test plans, such as bowling first with three spinners, before the match.
Its first requirement is a set of measured parameters. The warehouse already provides the main ones.

sections.heading: The Parameters
body: At Eden Gardens, the average first-innings score is {{ev:tw-first-home}} against {{ev:tw-first-other}} elsewhere, and chasing sides win {{ev:tw-chase-home}} of decided matches against {{ev:tw-chase-other}}. There are {{ev:tw-six-home}} sixes per match, against {{ev:tw-six-other}}.
Since 2022, pace has cost {{ev:tw-hp}} an over at the ground and spin {{ev:tw-hs}}, against {{ev:tw-op}} and {{ev:tw-os}} at other venues. The chart compares them.

sections.heading: Proposal: Building the Twin
body: Proposal: combine these parameters with ball-by-ball outcome rates by phase and bowling type to simulate innings at the ground, then validate the simulated totals against real ones.

sections.heading: What Is Missing
body: A full twin would need pitch reports, weather, dew and boundary dimensions, none of which are in the warehouse. Bowling type is known for bowlers delivering {{ev:tw-cover}} of balls at the ground.
Those gaps limit how far the twin could be trusted for a specific match.

sections.heading: CricField Verdict: The Core Is Ready
body: The core parameters for a Eden Gardens twin are measurable today. Adding conditions data would turn it into a planning tool.
Kolkata Knight Riders could validate it against every home match as the season goes on.
